entities.summary: Ove Verner Hansen was a Danish opera singer and actor. He played the character, "Bøffen" in 16 of the Olsen-banden-movies. He played a tall, large, and slow-moving henchman, often seen lifting Egon Olsen up over his head, carrying him under one arm, and trying to kill him.
